prompt:
Using only the provided files, judge the claim below about RUN-SYN-07.
Claim: RUN-SYN-07 reached a final biomass concentration of 12 g/L.
Answer with exactly one label on the first line: Support, Refute, or NEI.
If the label is Support or Refute, quote the exact sentence from the provided files on the next line.
answer:
NEI

提供的文件中没有 RUN-SYN-07 生物量（biomass）浓度的任何记录。该批次记录只有 PMA 效价：`- 72 h: PMA titer reached 21.4 g/L (HPLC, single injection, no replicate recorded)` [证据: batch-record-RUN-SYN-07.md#1]。仪器导出中只有 TEMP、PH、DO 三项，也不含生物量 [证据: instrument-export-RUN-SYN-07.csv#1]。因此“终止生物量 12 g/L”既不被支持也无法被反驳，属无法从现有证据确定（NEI）；且按规则，NEI 不附引文行。
